text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I am deeply sorry. 
I... ended up losing...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even with all that support from everyone 
back in Hidaka... 
To end up with such a pathetic result...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Tore-san. 
I shouldn't be acting like this, should I?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Moping around will only make everyone 
worry 
about me even more.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. No matter how much I regret it, 
it won't bring back the prey that got 
away.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
What matters here is facing it head-on. 
If you panic and switch your target right 
away, 
you'll only end up letting that one slip 
away, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure racing works the same way... 
So I'll reflect thoroughly and carry those 
lessons 
into the next race!

Then let's reflect together and retrain

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will sharpen my running even further— 
and seize victory next time, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So please, don't hold back 
when planning my training menu.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll take this defeat to heart and make it 
my strength— 
I promise you, I will come back stronger.
